title: F30–F39: Mood disorders
author: Dr. Mayurakshi Katiyar
footnote: Source: Davidson's Principles & Practice of Medicine, 24th ed (p1241–1242, p1253–1254) · ICD-10 sub-codes: WHO · For medical students · Educational, not treatment advice

slides.line: Aam logon mein ~5% ko depression. Medical patients mein 10–20%
slides.cta: Disability aur suicide ka bada kaaran · swipe karo →

slides.title: Mood ke 7 codes
slides.note: ⚠ Sub-codes: WHO ICD-10 (not in Davidson). Davidson Box 31.1: F30–F39 mood (affective) disorders: depression, bipolar disorder.

slides.title: 3 tarah ke mood disorders
items: Unipolar depression: ek ya zyada low mood episodes
Bipolar disorder: high (mania) aur low (depression) dono
Bas itna yaad rakho: neeche, upar-neeche, aur halka lamba

slides.title: Depression sirf mann ki nahi, sharir ki bhi
Bimaar patient mein depression kaise pakdein?
items: Weight loss, thakaan, neend: bimari se bhi hote hain

slides.title: Asli culprit: thyroid, steroid, stroke?
items: Brain: stroke, tumour, MS, Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, epilepsy
Infections: glandular fever, herpes simplex, typhoid

slides.title: Poochne se risk nahi badhta
items: Mood bahut low ho to suicide ke baare mein seedha poochho
Na poochna = bachaane ka mauka khona
Depression ke baad suicide risk 10 guna

slides.title: Genes + bachpan + loss
items: Trigger: loss ya badlaav wale life events, bimari
Serotonin, noradrenaline kam kaam karte hain
HPA axis: cortisol badha, dexamethasone se suppress nahi

slides.title: Dawa bhi, baat bhi: dono kaam karte
items: Theek hone ke baad 6–12 mahine continue

slides.line: Ek episode ke baad 50% se zyada, teen ke baad 90% se zyada ko depression phir hota hai
slides.cta: Isliye theek hone ke baad bhi follow-up zaroori

slides.title: Depression ka ulta: Mania
items: Neend aur bhook kam, undue optimism

slides.title: Hypomania vs Mania
slides.note: Psychosis dono phase (depression, mania) mein, mood ke hisaab se: affective psychosis

slides.title: Bipolar: upar bhi, neeche bhi
items: Trigger: bimari, neend ki kami, steroids
Mania aksar depression ke pehle ya baad

slides.title: Pehle dawa check karo
items: Herbal, OTC aur recreational drugs bhi poochho

slides.title: Bipolar mein ye galti mat karna
items: Sirf antidepressant: mania mein 'switch' ho sakta hai
Mood stabiliser saath mein · lithium first choice
Lithium: narrow range, regular blood level, thyroid + kidney check
Lithium 1st trimester mein nahi · valproate childbearing age mein nahi
Dawa achanak band karne se relapse

slides.title: Save karo, viva mein kaam aayega
slides.line: Comment karo: anhedonia ka matlab kya hai?
